chapters.reason: Converts fixed-architecture Transformers into hidden-state RNNs via targeted fine-tuning/distillation, replacing quadratic self-attention with sub-quadratic mixers and a recurrent state.
Involves linear-state recurrence with matrix-valued hidden states, aligning with the paper's focus on linearized, recurrent computation.
Relates to training-induced recurrence (implicit recurrence through training without structural changes); relevant but less directly aligned with the architectural conversion focus.
